_comment: One NASA Image and Video Library image per chosen story beat. Captions are ours and must agree with NASA's title/description (shown in the review checklist). illustration=true marks artist's concepts. 'portrait' is the explorer's hardware photo used as a thumbnail on the globe, map and panel.

why.caption: Buzz Aldrin after setting up Apollo 11's science experiments on the Moon, 20 July 1969.

how.caption: Close-up of the laser ranging retroreflector left on the Moon by the Apollo 14 astronauts, February 1971.

now.caption: The Apollo 15 laser ranging retroreflector site, seen from orbit by NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter.

portrait.caption: The laser ranging retroreflector left by Apollo 14.

why.caption: Buzz Aldrin walks beside one of Eagle's landing legs, 20 July 1969. Photo by Neil Armstrong.

now.caption: The plaque the Apollo 11 astronauts left on the Moon.

portrait.caption: The Apollo 11 lunar module resting on the Moon, 20 July 1969.

why.caption: James Irwin works at the Lunar Roving Vehicle during the first Apollo 15 moonwalk, 31 July 1971.

now.caption: The Apollo 15 site seen from orbit by NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter. The rover (LRV) and Falcon's descent stage are labelled.

portrait.caption: The Lunar Roving Vehicle on the Moon during Apollo 15.

why.caption: A Mars Exploration Rover like Spirit on the surface of Mars.

discovered.caption: Bright soil churned up by Spirit's dragging wheel near Home Plate, May 2007.

lastDay.caption: Stuck in soft soil at a place called Troy, Spirit photographed its own underside in June 2009 to help engineers plan its escape.

now.caption: Spirit's view from Troy, where it came to rest.

portrait.caption: A Mars Exploration Rover like Spirit.

discovered.caption: The first photograph ever taken on the surface of Mars, by Viking 1 minutes after landing on 20 July 1976.

lastDay.caption: Sunset at the Viking Lander 1 site.

now.caption: The first colour image from Viking Lander 1.

portrait.caption: A Viking lander. NASA's Viking project landed two of these laboratories on Mars in 1976.

why.caption: The flight model of NASA's Ingenuity Mars Helicopter.

discovered.caption: Ingenuity after its first flight, seen by Perseverance's Mastcam-Z cameras.

lastDay.caption: After its 72nd flight, Ingenuity photographed the shadow of its damaged rotor blade.

now.caption: Ingenuity at "Valinor Hills", seen by Perseverance in February 2024.

portrait.caption: The flight model of NASA's Ingenuity Mars Helicopter.

how.caption: Dawn's ion engine glowing blue as it arrives at Ceres.

discovered.caption: Asteroid Vesta, photographed by Dawn's framing camera on 24 July 2011.

now.caption: Occator Crater, home of the brightest spots on Ceres, seen by Dawn.

portrait.caption: Dawn arriving at the dwarf planet Ceres.

now.caption: The "saddle" region of Eros, where NEAR Shoemaker later touched down, imaged from 208 km away in March 2000.

why.caption: Pioneer 10 being readied for launch at Cape Kennedy in 1972.

how.caption: The Pioneer 10 plaque positioned on the spacecraft.

discovered.caption: Jupiter photographed by Pioneer 10 from about 2.6 million km away, December 1973.

portrait.caption: Pioneer 10 being readied for launch in 1972.
Surveyor 3 in its crater, photographed by the Apollo 12 astronauts in November 1969.
Sojourner on Mars, imaged by the Mars Pathfinder lander.
A Viking lander. NASA's Viking project landed two of these laboratories on Mars in 1976.
The Phoenix Mars Lander on Mars.
InSight's first full selfie on Mars, December 2018.
The plaque carried by both Pioneer 10 and Pioneer 11.
